card.name: Many equal-area triangles from 30 planar points

task.name: Many equal-area triangles from 30 planar points
task.description: construct() -> exactly 30 distinct integer coordinate pairs in [-30,30]^2. Compute the absolute determinant for every triple, exclude zero-area triples, and maximize the largest multiplicity of a single positive doubled area. The local bounded integer configurations give lower constructions for positive-area multiplicity; they do not reproduce the paper's asymptotic upper-bound proof.
